_comment: Phase-2 triage (docs/TOOL_TRIAGE_DRAFT.md §3a): 12 raw FastLink tools + ask_caller/report_done = 14. fast_click_xy stays until the fast_click{x,y} fold lands in tools.js. fast_evaluate dropped 2026-09-15: disabled on the runner's relay account, 11/32 cells wasted a call on it. Select with --toolset phase2. Descriptions keyed by REAL tool name.

describe.fast_snapshot: Read the current page: interactive elements (text, label, live value, coords) plus readable content blocks; a result that starts with truncated:true is partial — call again with full:true (or limit:N) before relying on it. Pass overlay:true when an open menu's options are missing; avoid viewport:true (it hides every control below the fold).
describe.fast_text: Return the page's innerText (or one element's via selector; html:true for outerHTML) — the exact source for data extraction such as tables and lists. truncated:true (first field) means more text exists: call again with a larger maxLen or a narrower selector.
describe.fast_click: Click the element whose text/label/placeholder matches `text` (narrow with role, tag, or index = the N-th match in document order — NOT a snapshot id); the result leads with url/urlChanged/focused and a fresh snapshot, so do not call fast_snapshot right after. On a miss nothing was clicked: retry with a name from `candidates`/`available`, and if settling:true the page was still loading — fast_wait for the target text first.
describe.fast_click_xy: Trusted click at viewport CSS coordinates x,y; returns no snapshot. Only when fast_click cannot match the element (canvas, cross-origin iframe).
describe.fast_fill: Set one field by label/placeholder/name (`match`, `value`; disambiguate with index or section); replaces the existing value and returns the field's live `value` with verified:true/false FIRST, then a fresh snapshot — report `value`, not what you sent. On a miss the result lists `candidates` (visible fields) and `hiddenMatches`: retry with one of those names or open the control that reveals the field; a field that only appears after another choice (such as a type dropdown) must be filled after that choice.
describe.fast_select_option: Choose `option` in the dropdown named `field` (its label, placeholder, or the heading above it; native, react-select, Angular, ARIA); the result leads with verified, picked, `value` (what the control shows now) and `field` (which dropdown it acted on) — check both before reporting. On a miss retry with a name from `candidates`; use selections:{field:option} to set several in one call.
describe.fast_key_press: Press `key` (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown...) on the focused element; returns the target, url/urlChanged and a fresh settled snapshot so you can see what the key did.
describe.fast_scroll: Scroll the page or the nearest scroll container: to:"top"|"bottom"|"50%" or pixels (negative = up). Returns a fresh snapshot.
describe.fast_wait: Wait until `text` appears (case-insensitive substring — use two or more words or an exact phrase, a single common word matches elsewhere) or, with networkIdle:true, until requests settle. Use after an action that triggers async loading; returns the matched element and a snapshot, or the visible headings on timeout.
describe.fast_tab: Open `url` in a new tab and focus it.
describe.fast_nav: Go to `url` in the current tab and wait for the load (waitMs, default 10s).
describe.fast_batch: Run several tool calls in order in one round-trip (actions:[{name,args}]); stops at the first failure unless continueOnError. Use when the next steps are already certain.
describe.report_done: Finish the task: result = the outcome in at most 3 short sentences that quote names, numbers and field values EXACTLY as the page shows them (no abbreviations, rounding or paraphrase); evidence = ONE short quote copied verbatim from your last fast_snapshot/fast_text result plus its URL. Refused unless a read followed your last action and the evidence quote matches a tool result.
